evidence.activity: Long-running donations and social activities for a rural primary school
evidence.quote: YANTIAN donated necessities to, and organised social activities for, Y unnan Hope Primary School for the 22nd consecutive year.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Responsible Business > Community Engagement

evidence.activity: Youth education support through sponsored educational programmes and scholarships
evidence.quote: In support of youth education, the T rust continues to support academic excellence through various channels, including sponsoring educational programmes, awarding scholarships and donating daily necessities.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Responsible Business > Community Engagement

community.criterion: level 2: specific external education activity, limited in reach (no figures)

evidence.activity: Summer placements for local students across HIT functions
evidence.quote: This summer, 10 local students were offered placement opportunities to gain first-hand experience across various HIT functions.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Responsible Business > Community Engagement

community.criterion: level 2: specific external education activity, limited in reach

evidence.activity: Sponsorship of a seafarers' welfare facility run by a maritime charity
evidence.quote: HIT made HK$250,000 sponsorship to The Mariners, the new establishment of the Sailors Home & Mission to Seafarers, an organisation dedicated to supporting the wellbeing of seafarers.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Responsible Business > Community Engagement > Case Study: The Mariners

community.criterion: level 2: specific community investment, limited in scale

evidence.activity: Volunteer programmes and festive celebrations for elderly people
evidence.quote: The T rust hosted a range of creative programmes and festive celebrations for the elderly to help combat social isolation and loneliness, while enhancing their overall wellbeing.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Responsible Business > Community Engagement

community.criterion: level 2: specific community volunteering activity, limited in reach

evidence.activity: Sustainability and decarbonisation workshop for key suppliers
evidence.quote: 96 key suppliers attended the workshop onsite on 15 July, gaining a better understanding of their own decarbonisation goals and learning about the decarbonisation ambitions of Hutchison Ports and its group companies.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Supply Chain Management > Case Study: Supplier Training on Sustainability

community.criterion: level 2: specific external training for supply-chain partners, limited reach

evidence.activity: Named talent development programme for employees
evidence.quote: YANTIAN upgraded the Commercial T rainee Programme and launched Relay 2030, a 22-month T alent Development Programme, selecting 20 participants from various departments.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Our People > Knowledge Empowerment > Case Study: Talent Development at YANTIAN

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Gold sponsorship of and employee participation in a disability-inclusion fundraising run
evidence.quote: As a Gold Sponsor of the 2025 CareER RunnERthon, 100 employees from HPH T rust and Hutchison Ports Hong Kong offices formed 20 teams to participate in the event, while another 45 employees in 9 teams joined the activity internally.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Our People > Diversity and Inclusion > Case Study: HIT Champions Disability Inclusion through CareER Initiatives

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific disability-inclusion activity, limited in reach

evidence.activity: Participation in an external disability inclusion index to review and track the inclusion roadmap
evidence.quote: Additionally, HIT participated in the CareER Disability Inclusion Index, allowing the company to strategically review its disability inclusion roadmap and regularly track performance.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Our People > Diversity and Inclusion > Case Study: HIT Champions Disability Inclusion through CareER Initiatives

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific inclusive workplace practice, no reach figures

evidence.activity: Inclusive recruitment of interns with disabilities and from ethnic minority backgrounds
evidence.quote: During summer 2025, HIT successfully engaged seven CareER interns and recruited an intern from an ethnic minority background through another non-profit organisation.
evidence.section: Annual report > Sustainability Report > Our People > Diversity and Inclusion

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific inclusive recruitment activity, limited in reach

creativity.reason: Level 0: the report fully describes a container port business with no creative activity; 'strategic storytelling' training and an upcycling workshop are traps or incidental.

community.reason: Level 2: several specific external education and community investment activities, but all limited in reach (total community contributions are small and most programmes give no beneficiary figures), plus employee development.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current disability and ethnic-minority inclusion practices, but with small reach (seven interns, employee participation in a fundraising run) rather than substantial measured reach.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: rests on general language only; the report shows the company's own innovation and services to exporters and shipping lines, with no specific service enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: Sustainability reporting scope covers only HIT and YANTIAN (about 90% of throughput). 'Community Engagement' was downgraded from a Material Topic to a Relevant Topic in 2025. Total community contributions were HK$0.7m (performance table). Board gender diversity (44% female) is demographic disclosure only and was not scored. A fatal traffic incident involving an external truck driver at YANTIAN in November 2025 is a safety matter, not a rights finding. No discrimination, harassment or labour-rights cases were reported.
